verdict: NO money-path strategy change. One telemetry correction shipped. The 0.99 cap is NOT promotable on OOS evidence; aggressive repricing already EXISTS and is DISABLED.

item1_aggressive_repricing.finding: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED IN THE CANONICAL ENGINE, AND STRICTLY SAFER THAN THE FADER.

existing_code_to_reuse.l5_two_sided_probe.completion_requote: the whole of item 1. Takes resting_own_px, resting_qty, resting_filled_qty (partial-fill aware), bid/ask/tick, held_qty/held_cost_usd, residual_budget_usd, book_age_s, gap_suspected, orders_uncertain, queue_ahead/queue_ahead_fn/require_queue_evidence, cancel_unresolved, min_ticks_behind. Moves a non-filling completion TOWARD THE TOUCH.
existing_code_to_reuse.l5_two_sided_probe.max_completion_price: the ceiling calculator. Already takes pair_cap and theta as PARAMETERS, and held_cost_usd is documented as the cash actually paid, FEES INCLUDED -- exactly the per-lot actual cost basis item 2 requires.
existing_code_to_reuse.l5_two_sided_probe.completion_ceiling: min of COMPLETION_CEILINGS_IN_FORCE = (improves, within_budget); falls back to the stricter opening cap when unreadable
existing_code_to_reuse.l5_pmus_live_runner.maybe_completion_req: the tick-loop call site, present in L5_LIVE_TICK_STAGES every tick

why_it_is_safer_than_the_fader: completion_requote REFUSES on cancel_unresolved: a cancel we could not prove landed is a live order until the venue says otherwise. Backed by a real incident -- the 0145z/0200z campaign produced ten requotes and not one clean cancel: seven returned verify_error HTTPError and three returned still_open with ORDER_STATE_NEW and full leaves_qty.
it REFUSES on orders_uncertain: we cannot cancel what we cannot name, and replacing would risk two live orders on one slot
it REFUSES on gap_suspected and on book_age_s > MAX_BOOK_AGE_S
every refusal leaves the existing order resting under existing controls, which is always safe
by contrast _lip_quoter.cancel() swallows every non-404 error to stderr and PROCEEDS; adopting that behaviour would be a REGRESSION
what_the_fader_has_that_we_do_not: _lip_quoter.sync_market cancel-fast/place-throttled asymmetry: cancels never throttled, placements gated by MIN_REPLACE_S=60s per (market,side) plus a per-day budget, and a throttled reprice CANCELS then SKIPS the replacement, deliberately leaving nothing resting
_lip_quoter.reconcile_presence: polls resting orders, detects externally vanished ones with a 30s indexing grace, drops them so the throttled path re-arms, and force_halts after 3 vanishings
_lip_quoter.boot_cancel_stale/refuse_boot: CANCEL FIRST DIE SECOND -- a refused boot sweeps every prefix-scoped resting order before exiting
the alone_at_top retreat: if the level is only us, cancel
item1_aggressive_repricing.the_actual_blocker: completion_requote_enabled() reads L5_COMPLETION_REQUOTE and DEFAULTS TO OFF. The live deployment shows maybe_completion_requote in L5_LIVE_TICK_STAGES at 0.000s on every tick -- the loop looks healthy while the path does nothing. L5_TS_REQUOTE seen in the campaign is a DIFFERENT mechanism, the OPENING-leg requote. So the complement never repriced because the switch is unset, not because of a defect.
item1_aggressive_repricing.shipped: completion_requote_enabled added to L5_EFFECTIVE_RUNTIME_CONFIG as an observed-not-graded row, beside book_completion_enabled. Telemetry only: identical PASS, failed set and checked count with the switch on or off. This is the same failure mode that hid L5_BOOK_COMPLETION for two months -- a switch whose state could only be inferred from missing counters.

item2_conditional_099.feasibility: FEASIBLE at the tick size. The 1c grid and fee rounding admit a 0.99 net ceiling; on the four venue-confirmed fills the maker rebate rounds to /bin/bash.00 at 2300z (raw 0.00372 < 0.005 floor) and to -0.0049/unit at 2230z, so fees do not consume the 3c of headroom.
item2_conditional_099.basis: 2300z: +0.0336 matched instead of -0.3528 stranded (true venue basis)
item2_conditional_099.oos_verdict: NOT PROMOTABLE. On the 19-window replay the 0.99 stranded-only cap improves TRAIN (-0.63 -> +0.45) and WORSENS HOLDOUT (-2.53 -> -2.83). It buys 3 completions priced between 0.96 and 0.99, and those dearer pairs do not pay for themselves out of sample.
item2_conditional_099.gap_found_not_fixed: max_completion_price takes an AGGREGATE held_cost_usd, so multiple lots at different acquisition prices are averaged. The owner forbids averaging profitable and unprofitable lots in a way that disguises losses. Implementing a per-lot ceiling is a real change and is NOT made here, because the cap it would serve does not survive OOS.

item3_abcd.basis: REPLAY, 19 windows, chronological 11 train / 8 holdout. OPENING POLICY IDENTICAL IN ALL ARMS so only completion differs. Completion is MAKER-ONLY in all four arms (the taker path is removed to isolate repricing), so absolute levels are NOT comparable to earlier runs that included taker completion.
item3_abcd.reading: B is the ONLY arm improving BOTH halves (+0.46 train, +0.86 holdout). The benefit is in the REPRICING, not in the 0.99 cap. D beats A and C but is worse than B alone, so the cap subtracts from the repricing gain.
item3_abcd.B_and_D_are_ORACLES: instant repricing, always successful, no queue, no cancel latency, no cancel failure. An UPPER BOUND, not an achievable result.

simulation_fidelity.verdict: THE AVAILABLE TAPES CANNOT RELIABLY SIMULATE CANCELLATION AND REPLACEMENT.
reasons: tick cadence: median 4.4s, p90 28.9s, max 38.8s. The measured cancel round-trip is 1.021-1.072s and the ack 0.09-0.42s, so an entire cancel-and-replace cycle completes INSIDE one median tape interval and is unobservable.

depth is TOUCH-ONLY (bid_shares/ask_shares). There is no per-level ladder, and our own quote rests 2 ticks BEHIND the touch where the tape carries no depth at all, so queue position at our price is not derivable.
shares_traded is cumulative with a delta on only 29 of 61 ticks, and the delta cannot be attributed to a price level, so it cannot clear a modelled queue.
no order-level events: no acks, no partial-fill prints, no cancel confirmations. Partial-fill and cancellation races have no observable counterpart.
minimum_additional_evidence_required: order-level event capture from the executor: submit, ack, partial fill, cancel request, cancel ack, terminal state, each with a venue timestamp. This exists in L5_FILL_CALIB_PRESUBMIT-class rows for OUR orders and needs to be retained for a campaign rather than lost with the container.
per-level book depth at and around our own quote price, not just the touch, at <=1s cadence.
our own queue position within the level. Our pre-submit rows currently carry our_position_within_level: UNKNOWN against 52,000-100,000 shares of touch depth for a 2-contract clip.
a bounded live campaign with L5_COMPLETION_REQUOTE enabled and nothing else changed, which is the only way to measure real cancel/replace outcomes.

safety.cancel_margin: 300s PRESERVED. The earlier 300->180 change stays reverted and the code floor remains raise-only.
safety.preserved: exact-order cancellation, reconciliation, watchdog, HALT, capital caps, daily-loss controls all untouched
safety.executor: disarmed; no live orders; no flag enabled by this work
